svg.text: Bus pull-ups are the STM32 internal pull-ups,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: enabled in firmware. Roughly 40 kΩ — weak, but enough for one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: device on a short bus at 100 kHz.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The AM2320 reports both the chamber temperature and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: headspace humidity, so no analog channel and no divider are

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: needed. Mount it inside the headspace, not outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: no external parts, nothing to wire

svg.text: The UNO Q carries four on-board RGB LEDs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two are driven by the Linux MPU, two by the STM32.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This design uses the two MCU-side LEDs, so there are

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: no indicator LEDs, resistors or switching transistor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every rail is 3.3 V. The UNO Q headers are not 5 V like an UNO R3.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 5 V divider or pull-up exceeds the 3.6 V absolute maximum on the analog and digital pins.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Status indication uses the two MCU-side on-board RGB LEDs (LED3 and LED4), so no GPIO is spent on it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One component total: the AM2320. If I2C reads fail CRC intermittently, fit real 4.7k-10k pull-ups.
